title: sphaeralcea rivularis
intro: Sphaeralcea rivularis, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Desert Marigold are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
